vision_mission_frame.vision: Filipinos who love their country and whose values and competencies enable them to realize their full potential and contribute meaningfully to building the nation.
vision_mission_frame.mission: To protect and promote the right of every Filipino to quality, equitable, culture-based, and complete basic education that: (a) makes them globally competitive, (b) fosters a deep sense of patriotism and national pride, and (c) prepares them for productive civic engagement and meaningful participation in the broader community.
